2016 Ford Explorer Limited 4WD Vehicle DescriptionIntroductionThe 2016 Ford Explorer Limited 4WD is a refined and capable midsize SUV that blends powerful performance, upscale comfort, advanced technology, and impressive versatility. Designed to accommodate families and drivers who need both passenger space and cargo flexibility, the Explorer Limited offers seating for up to seven passengers along with premium materials and a wide range of convenience features. With its bold exterior design, smooth ride quality, and intelligent four-wheel-drive capability, this SUV is well suited for daily commuting, road trips, and weekend adventures. The Explorer s strong reputation for reliability and practicality makes it one of the most popular SUVs in its class.Performance
  • Engine: 3.5-liter Ti-VCT V6
  • Horsepower: 290 hp @ 6,500 rpm
  • Torque: 255 lb-ft @ 4,000 rpm
  • Transmission: 6-speed SelectShift automatic transmission
  • Drivetrain: Intelligent Four-Wheel Drive (4WD)
  • Fuel Economy (EPA est.): ~16 MPG city/~22 MPG highway
  • Fuel Tank Capacity: Approximately 18.6 gallons
  • Maximum Towing Capacity: Up to 5,000 lbs when properly equipped
  • Suspension: Independent front and rear suspension for balanced comfort and handling
The Explorer Limited s 3.5-liter V6 engine delivers smooth acceleration and strong power for highway merging, towing, and everyday driving. Paired with a responsive 6-speed automatic transmission, it offers confident performance and dependable reliability. The intelligent 4WD system automatically adjusts power distribution between the wheels to improve traction and stability in rain, snow, or rough road conditions. This combination of power and control makes the Explorer capable of handling a wide range of driving situations with ease.Interior & Comfort
  • Seating Capacity: Up to 7 passengers
  • Premium leather-trimmed seating surfaces
  • Heated and ventilated front seats
  • Heated second-row seats
  • Power-adjustable driver and passenger seats with memory settings
  • Power-folding third-row seats
  • Heated leather-wrapped steering wheel
  • Dual-zone automatic climate control
  • Spacious three-row interior with supportive seating and soft-touch materials
Inside, the Explorer Limited offers a comfortable and upscale cabin designed for both convenience and luxury. Leather seating surfaces provide a refined feel, while heated and ventilated front seats ensure comfort in all seasons. The second row also features heated seating for added passenger comfort. With generous headroom and legroom across all three rows, passengers can enjoy long journeys in comfort. The power-folding third row allows easy transformation between passenger seating and expanded cargo space.Technology & Infotainment
  • Touchscreen infotainment display
  • Bluetooth hands-free calling and audio streaming
  • Voice-activated controls
  • Premium multi-speaker audio system
  • SiriusXM satellite radio capability
  • USB ports and auxiliary audio input
  • Steering-wheel-mounted audio and cruise controls
  • Smart key with push-button start
  • Remote engine start system
The Explorer Limited s technology features help keep drivers connected and entertained on the road. Bluetooth connectivity allows hands-free communication and music streaming, while voice-activated controls and steering-wheel buttons help minimize distractions while driving.Dimensions & Capacity
  • Wheelbase: 112.8 inches
  • Overall Length: 198.3 inches
  • Overall Width: 78.9 inches
  • Overall Height: Approximately 70 inches
  • Passenger Volume: Around 170 cubic feet
  • Cargo Space Behind Third Row: ~21 cubic feet
  • Maximum Cargo Capacity: ~81.7 cubic feet
The Explorer s well-engineered interior design offers generous space for passengers while maintaining excellent cargo flexibility. Even with all three rows in use, there is ample storage space for everyday items. Folding the second and third rows opens up a large cargo area for luggage, sports equipment, or larger items.Exterior Features
  • Bold and muscular SUV styling
  • Chrome-accented front grille and exterior trim
  • LED signature lighting and daytime running lights
  • Power liftgate for easy cargo access
  • Roof rails for additional cargo capability
  • Heated power exterior mirrors
  • Stylish aluminum alloy wheels
  • Rear spoiler and aerodynamic body lines
The exterior of the Explorer Limited combines rugged capability with modern styling. Sculpted body lines and chrome accents give the SUV a refined yet powerful presence on the road, while functional features like roof rails and a power liftgate enhance everyday convenience.Safety & Driver Assistance
  • Rearview backup camera
  • Blind Spot Information System (BLIS )
  • Rear Cross-Traffic Alert
  • Electronic Stability Control
  • Traction Control System
  • Anti-lock Braking System (ABS)
  • Advanced multi-stage airbag system
  • Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS)
  • Available adaptive cruise control and lane departure warning
Safety and driver confidence are key aspects of the Explorer Limited s design. Stability and traction systems help maintain control in challenging road conditions, while driver-assistance technologies improve awareness and support safer driving.Highlights
  • Powerful 290-hp 3.5-liter V6 engine
  • Intelligent 4-Wheel Drive capability
  • Spacious three-row seating for up to seven passengers
  • Premium leather interior with heated and ventilated seats
  • Power-folding third-row seating for flexible cargo space
  • Modern infotainment system with Bluetooth connectivity
  • Strong 5,000-lb towing capacity
  • Bold SUV styling with chrome accents and alloy wheels
SummaryThe 2016 Ford Explorer Limited 4WD delivers a strong balance of power, luxury, and versatility in a capable midsize SUV. Its dependable V6 engine and intelligent four-wheel-drive system provide confident performance in a variety of driving conditions, while the spacious three-row interior offers comfort for both driver and passengers. Premium materials, modern technology, and flexible cargo configurations make it well suited for family life, road trips, and everyday commuting. With its bold styling, advanced safety features, and proven reliability, the Explorer Limited remains an excellent choice for drivers seeking a well-equipped and capable SUV.

The 2013 INFINITI FX37 is a luxurious SUV that blends style, performance, and innovative features perfectly. This vehicle is equipped with an impressive VQ 3.7L V-6 VVEL DOHC engine that delivers 325 horsepower and is paired with a smooth 7-speed automatic transmission. The FX37 is designed to offer an exhilarating driving experience while ensuring comfort for all occupants.

One of the standout features of the FX37 is the rear camera, which provides enhanced visibility of obstacles and hazards behind the vehicle. This extra set of eyes not only offers convenience but also enhances safety, making it easier to navigate tight spaces. Coupled with brake assist, which senses panic braking and boosts stopping power, the FX37 helps prevent accidents before they occur.

Long road trips are a breeze with the cruise control equipped with steering wheel-mounted controls, allowing you to set your desired speed effortlessly. This feature minimizes driver fatigue, making every journey more enjoyable. Additionally, the power open and close liftgate provides on-demand access to the cargo area, simplifying loading and unloading when your hands are full.

Comfort is paramount in the FX37, with heated driver and front passenger seat cushions that offer warmth during cold weather. The luxurious leather seat upholstery adds a touch of elegance to the interior, while the first-row power express open/close sunroof allows for a light and airy cabin feel, perfect for enjoying sunny days or stargazing at night.

Furthermore, the first-row sunshade lets you control the amount of light entering the cabin, enhancing comfort and privacy. The power reclining driver seat, along with power 2-way lumbar support and various height adjustments, ensures that you can find your ideal driving position for maximum comfort.

The FX37’s engine benefits from variable valve timing, allowing for improved fuel efficiency and performance at all RPMs. The sequential multi-point electronic fuel injection system further enhances combustion efficiency, leading to better fuel economy and cleaner emissions.

Overall, the 2013 INFINITI FX37 is a remarkable vehicle that combines luxury, safety, and advanced technology, making it an excellent choice for anyone seeking a premium SUV experience. Whether youre commuting through the city or embarking on an adventure, the FX37 is ready to deliver an unforgettable ride.

description: The 2013 Ford Escape Titanium AWD 4-door SUV is a well-rounded compact crossover that blends everyday comfort, modern technology, and capable all-weather performance. Positioned near the top of the Escape lineup, the Titanium trim focuses on upscale features and amenities that increase convenience and comfort for drivers and passengers alike. With its available all-wheel-drive system, the Escape Titanium is equally suited for handling daily commutes, family errands, and weekend adventures in varying road conditions. Under the hood, the 2013 Escape Titanium typically offers a choice between two four-cylinder engines, with the 2.0-liter EcoBoost turbocharged engine being a popular option on higher trims. This engine provides a lively balance of power and efficiency, delivering strong acceleration for merging on highways and confidence when passing. The standard 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine also delivers smooth and dependable performance with good fuel economy. Both engines pair with a six-speed automatic transmission that shifts smoothly and aids in maximizing fuel efficiency while keeping driving dynamics responsive. The AWD system on the Escape Titanium continuously monitors traction and automatically sends power to the rear wheels when needed. This enhances stability and grip during rain, snow, and slippery surfaces, improving driver confidence without requiring any input from the driver. The SUV’s suspension strikes a balance between comfort and control, offering a composed ride on paved roads while still maintaining enough stiffness to handle winding backroads with minimal body roll. On the outside, the Escape Titanium features refined styling that gives it a more premium appearance compared with lower trims. Signature elements include distinctive alloy wheels, chrome accents, fog lights, and an elegant front grille. The overall design is aerodynamic yet muscular, with clean lines that project both strength and sophistication. Its compact size makes parking and maneuvering in urban environments easy, while the higher seating position gives drivers excellent visibility. Inside, the cabin of the Escape Titanium is spacious and thoughtfully laid out. Seating for five passengers is standard, with supportive front seats and plenty of room in the rear for adults on longer trips. The materials used throughout the interior are of higher quality than lower trims, including soft-touch surfaces and attractive trim pieces that give the SUV a more upscale feel. The Titanium trim also adds a number of desirable features such as leather upholstery, a premium audio system, dual-zone automatic climate control, a power liftgate, and an available navigation system. In terms of technology, the Escape Titanium includes SYNC voice-activated connectivity, Bluetooth hands-free calling, satellite radio, and steering-wheel-mounted controls that keep essential functions at the driver’s fingertips. Safety features are comprehensive, with a suite of airbags, stability and traction control systems, anti-lock brakes, and available rear-view camera or parking sensors for added convenience. Overall, the 2013 Ford Escape Titanium AWD offers a compelling mix of comfort, capability, and technology, making it a solid choice among compact SUVs for buyers who want a well-equipped vehicle that handles daily life with ease.

Discover the perfect blend of style, capability, and convenience in this 2019 Jeep Cherokee Latitude Plus. This SUV is ready to elevate your driving experience and take you on new adventures.

The Jeep Cherokee Latitude Plus comes equipped with a 2.4L I4 engine and a 9-Speed 948TE Automatic transmission, delivering an impressive 22 MPG in the city and 31 MPG on the highway. This front-wheel-drive SUV offers a smooth and efficient ride, making it the perfect companion for your daily commute or weekend getaways.

Designed with your comfort and convenience in mind, this Jeep Cherokee features a spacious interior with premium cloth and vinyl bucket seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, and a user-friendly Uconnect 4 infotainment system with a 7-inch display. Stay connected with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, while the 6-speaker audio system provides exceptional sound quality.

Safety is a top priority, and this Jeep Cherokee is equipped with a comprehensive suite of advanced safety features, including Dual Front Impact Airbags, Dual Front Side Impact Airbags, Knee Airbag, Overhead Airbag, Rear Side Impact Airbag, ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera, and Electronic Stability Control. You can drive with confidence, knowing you and your loved ones are well-protected.

The exterior of the Jeep Cherokee Latitude Plus exudes a bold and rugged presence, with a white paint finish and 17-inch Satin Carbon Aluminum wheels. The roof rails and power liftgate add both style and functionality, making it easy to load and unload your gear.

Experience the perfect blend of capability, comfort, and technology in this 2019 Jeep Cherokee Latitude Plus. Visit our showroom today and let us demonstrate how this exceptional SUV can enhance your driving experience.

Experience the versatility and style of the 2019 Chevrolet Blazer in its sleek Graphite Metallic exterior, complemented by a refined Jet Black interior. With 154,708 miles, it remains a compelling choice for those seeking a well-equipped, reliable vehicle. Modern connectivity features include Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, and a Wi-Fi hotspot, ensuring you stay connected on the go. Safety is enhanced with a backup camera, cross traffic alert, and keyless entry with push start. The vehicle also boasts satellite radio readiness and xenon headlights for improved visibility. The limited promotion options add stylish 20-inch gloss black painted aluminum wheels, a black bowtie package, and premium exterior and interior protection features. The Convenience and Driver Confidence Package elevates comfort with heated seats, rear power liftgate, roof rails, and lane change alerts, making every drive more secure and convenient.

2019 Chevrolet Blazer Safety and Security Features
This model is equipped with essential safety features including a rear seat reminder, driver knee airbags, 4-wheel anti-lock brakes, and anti-lockout power door locks. For added security, it features auto-locking door locks, a programmable safety key, and an electronic parking brake, providing peace of mind during every journey. These features work together to enhance occupant safety and vehicle control, making it a dependable choice for daily driving and long trips.

2019 Chevrolet Blazer Entertainment and Technology Features
Inside, the Blazer offers an 8-inch infotainment touchscreen with voice-operated radio and hands-free calling, allowing seamless integration with your smart devices via the myChevrolet app with Connected Access. Pandora internet radio provides endless entertainment options, while the systems six speakers deliver clear, immersive sound. The vehicle also supports app marketplace integration, electronic messaging assistance with read and voice features, ensuring you stay connected and entertained without distraction.

2019 Chevrolet Blazer Performance Features
This SUV features an electronic 4WD selector with a part-time 4WD system, giving you control over traction in various conditions. It also boasts cylinder deactivation technology, helping improve fuel efficiency during highway cruising. These performance features combine to offer a balanced drive with capable handling and optimized power delivery, suitable for both city streets and off-road adventures.

Buick Envision Essence Vehicle DescriptionIntroductionThe 2019 Buick Envision Essence is a premium compact luxury SUV that delivers a blend of refined comfort, advanced technology, confident performance, and everyday versatility. Positioned between traditional SUVs and more performance-oriented crossovers, the Envision Essence stands out with its upscale interior craftsmanship, smooth ride quality, and well-balanced driving dynamics. Ideal for daily commuting, family travel, or weekend adventures, the 2019 Envision Essence combines sophistication with practicality for drivers who want style, comfort, and capability in a single SUV.Performance
  • Engine: 2.0-liter turbocharged 4-cylinder
  • Horsepower: 252 hp
  • Torque: 260 lb-ft
  • Transmission: 9-speed automatic transmission
  • Drivetrain: All-Wheel Drive (AWD) available/Front-Wheel Drive (FWD) standard
  • Fuel Economy (Estimated): ~22-24 MPG city/~28-29 MPG highway
  • Suspension: Fully independent with twin-tube gas shocks for ride comfort
  • Steering: Precision steering with responsive handling characteristics
Powered by a refined 2.0-liter turbocharged engine, the Envision Essence delivers strong acceleration and confident passing power. The smooth 9-speed automatic transmission helps optimize fuel efficiency while enhancing mid-range power delivery. With available all-wheel drive for added traction in varied weather conditions and a well-balanced chassis setup, the Envision delivers composed handling and a comfortable ride whether navigating urban streets or cruising on the freeway.Interior & Comfort
  • Seating Capacity: 5 passengers
  • Leather-appointed seating surfaces
  • Heated front seats
  • Power-adjustable driver seat with memory function
  • Heated leather-wrapped steering wheel
  • Dual-zone automatic climate control
  • Buick QuietTuning noise reduction technology
  • Soft-touch materials and upscale trim accents
  • Spacious front and rear legroom
The interior of the Envision Essence emphasizes comfort and refinement. Leather-appointed seating and heated front seats provide a premium seating experience, while Buick s QuietTuning technology enhances cabin serenity by minimizing road and wind noise. Thoughtful details such as power adjustments, memory seating, and quality materials create an elevated environment for driver and passengers alike.Technology & Infotainment
  • Buick Infotainment System with touchscreen display
  • Apple CarPlay compatibility
  • Android Auto compatibility
  • Bluetooth hands-free phone and audio streaming
  • USB ports and auxiliary input
  • Available navigation system
  • Bose premium audio system (optional/available)
  • Steering wheel audio and cruise controls
The Buick infotainment system offers an intuitive interface with seamless smartphone integration via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto . Bluetooth connectivity and multiple USB ports make connecting and charging devices easy. Higher trim packages and options may include enhanced navigation and Bose premium audio for elevated entertainment quality.Dimensions & Capacity
  • Wheelbase: Approximately 110.5 inches
  • Overall Length: Approximately 184.3 inches
  • Overall Width: Approximately 72.9 inches
  • Overall Height: Approximately 64.8 inches
  • Passenger Volume: Spacious cabin for five occupants
  • Cargo Volume: Generous cargo space behind second row
  • Maximum Cargo with Seats Folded: Expanded cargo area for larger items
The 2019 Envision s thoughtfully engineered dimensions provide a roomy and comfortable cabin without compromising maneuverability. Its generous cargo area and split-folding rear seats allow easy accommodation of luggage, gear, or everyday essentials.Exterior Features
  • Signature Buick waterfall grille with chrome accents
  • LED daytime running lights
  • Bi-function projector automatic headlamps (depending on options)
  • Heated exterior mirrors
  • Available power liftgate
  • Alloy wheels with modern design
  • Sculpted body lines with refined styling cues
The exterior of the Envision Essence reflects Buick s attention to upscale design. Elegant styling elements like the signature grille, sculpted body panels, and distinctive lighting give the SUV a refined presence on the road. Available features such as heated mirrors and a power liftgate add convenience and premium touches.Safety & Driver Assistance
  • Comprehensive airbag protection system
  • Anti-lock Braking System (ABS)
  • StabiliTrak Electronic Stability Control
  • Traction Control
  • Rear Vision Camera
  • Rear Park Assist (available)
  • Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert (available)
  • Forward Collision Alert and Automatic Emergency Braking (available)
  • Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS)
Safety is a central focus for the 2019 Envision Essence, with a suite of advanced systems designed to help protect occupants and support driver awareness. Rear cameras and available assist technologies enhance confidence when parking and navigating traffic, while stability and braking systems help maintain secure handling in changing conditions.Highlights
  • Turbocharged 2.0-liter engine with 252 hp
  • Smooth-shifting 9-speed automatic transmission
  • Premium leather-appointed interior with heated front seats
  • Quiet interior with advanced noise reduction (QuietTuning )
  • Intuitive infotainment system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
  • Strong safety suite with available driver assistance features
  • Elegant Buick design and upscale presence
SummaryThe 2019 Buick Envision Essence is an exceptional choice for drivers who value a premium driving experience, refined comfort, and smart everyday functionality. Its powerful yet efficient turbocharged engine delivers responsive performance, while the smooth 9-speed automatic transmission enhances both power delivery and fuel economy. Inside, the upscale cabin offers heated leather seating, modern technology features, and Buick s QuietTuning system, ensuring a serene and enjoyable ride for all occupants. With thoughtful design, strong safety systems, and a versatile cargo area, the Envision Essence proves equally adept at daily commuting or weekend road trips. For drivers seeking sophistication, comfort, and capability in a compact luxury SUV package, the 2019 Buick Envision Essence exceeds expectations in comfort, performance, and value.

Introducing the sleek and powerful 2019 Volkswagen Tiguan! This stunning SUV is equipped with a 2.0L Turbo I4 engine, delivering an impressive 184 horsepower and 221 ft. lbs. of torque. But it's not just about performance with the Tiguan, it also offers ample space and comfort for you and your passengers. With spacious seating for up to seven, everyone can ride in style and comfort. Plus, the Tiguan's cargo area can be expanded up to 73.5 cubic feet, making it perfect for all your adventures and daily errands.

Not only does the Tiguan deliver on performance and space, but it also offers a range of modern features to enhance your driving experience. Stay connected with the available App-Connect system, which allows you to access your favorite apps, music, and navigation right from the touchscreen display. And with advanced safety features like blind spot monitoring, lane departure warning, and adaptive cruise control, you can have peace of mind on every journey.

Don't miss your chance to own this 2019 Volkswagen Tiguan with its impressive 2.0L Turbo I4 engine and 8-speed shiftable automatic transmission.
